evals.title: Editable install waits for the layout
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- `python -m skore_skills status` reports `env_manager: pixi`,
  `policy.env_manager: pixi`, `has_src: false`, `git: false`.
- `pixi.toml` and a `pixi init` `pyproject.toml` exist; no `src/`.
- Every `skills` entry is `true`.]

Continue the setup.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Read `status` first and treat the manager as already resolved. - Dispatch `setup-workspace` next, because the editable install needs `src/<pkg>/`. - Name `python -m skore_skills scaffold --package <pkg>` as the workspace action even though a manifest already exists. It must NOT: - Re-ask G-ENV-MGR. - Pass `--force` to `scaffold`. - Wire the editable install before the layout exists.
expectations: Read `status` first and treat the manager as already resolved.
Dispatch `setup-workspace` next, because the editable install needs `src/<pkg>/`.

Schedule `add-python-package` for the editable install only after `has_src` is true. Do not install sklearn/skrub/skore during setup.
Finish with `setup-git`.
The response does NOT: Re-ask G-ENV-MGR.
The response does NOT: Pass `--force` to `scaffold`.
The response does NOT: Wire the editable install before the layout exists.

evals.title: Git skill not installed
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- Empty folder.
- `python -m skore_skills status` reports `skills`:
  `setup-python-env: true`, `setup-workspace: true`,
  `setup-git: false`, `choose-python-library: true`,
  `persist-ml-git: false`, `triage-ml-task: true`.]

Bootstrap this project for me.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Dispatch the environment and workspace steps normally. - State in one line that git setup is skipped because `setup-git` is not installed. - Finish the rest of setup rather than stopping at the missing skill. It must NOT: - Run `git init`, `git add`, or `git commit` to cover for the missing skill. - Invent the `setup-git` procedure from memory. - Treat the missing skill as an error that aborts setup.
expectations: Dispatch the environment and workspace steps normally.
